name: SUMIFS
description: SUMIFS adds values that satisfy multiple criteria across one or more ranges.
tldr: Adds numbers that meet all of the specified conditions.

parameters.name: sum_range
parameters.description: The range of cells to sum.

parameters.name: criteria_range1
parameters.description: The range to evaluate with the first criteria.

parameters.name: criteria1
parameters.description: The condition that criteria_range1 must satisfy.

basicExample.description: Sum sales in the East region
basicExample.explanation: Adds values from B2:B100 only where A2:A100 equals "East".

advancedExamples.title: Multiple criteria
advancedExamples.description: Sum sales where region is East and product is Widget
advancedExamples.explanation: Both conditions must be true for the row to be included.

advancedExamples.title: Date range criteria
advancedExamples.explanation: Uses two date criteria on the same date column to define a range.

howItWorks: SUMIFS iterates through each row in the criteria ranges. A row is included only if every criterion is met. Then it sums the corresponding values from sum_range.

howToSteps.name: Select sum range
howToSteps.text: Choose the cells you want to add.

howToSteps.name: Add criteria range
howToSteps.text: Select the range that contains the first condition.

howToSteps.name: Repeat for more criteria
howToSteps.text: Add additional range/criteria pairs as needed.

limitations: All criteria ranges must be the same size and shape as sum_range.
Criteria are combined with AND logic; every condition must be true.
To sum if any condition is true (OR logic), use multiple SUMIF or SUM with addition.
Criteria cannot reference a cell outside the range.

commonErrors.cause: Criteria ranges are not the same size as sum_range.
commonErrors.fix: Ensure all ranges have the same number of rows and columns.

commonErrors.cause: Criteria string includes operators incorrectly, e.g. ">1000" without quotes.
commonErrors.fix: Use quotes for text and operators: ">1000" or cell reference.
Check criteria spelling and data types.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: SUMIFS works identically in Google Sheets.
googleSheetsEquivalent.notes: Same syntax and behavior as Excel.

faq.question: What is the difference between SUMIF and SUMIFS?
faq.answer: SUMIF handles one condition. SUMIFS handles one or more conditions.

faq.question: Can SUMIFS do OR logic?
faq.answer: No, it uses AND logic. For OR logic, add multiple SUMIFS results together.

faq.question: Can I use wildcards in SUMIFS?
faq.answer: Yes, use * for any characters and ? for a single character.

faq.question: Can criteria be in different columns?
faq.answer: Yes, each condition can reference a different column as long as ranges are the same size.
